caribbean.headline: Heavy Rain for St. Lucia, Moderate Seas Ahead
caribbean.paragraph: St. Lucia is seeing heavy showers with 75% rain probability, southeasterly winds up to 11 kt, and seas to 5.4 ft with an E swell and an 8 s period at the port. I note Roatan is the runner-up with winds up to 24 kt, which could produce choppier conditions for small craft, and I advise mariners to monitor local forecasts and exercise caution.

mediterranean.headline: Mykonos Winds Top 25 kt, Seas Near 7 ft
mediterranean.paragraph: Mykonos is experiencing sustained ENE winds around 25 kt with peak significant wave heights near 6.9 ft and an ENE swell period of 6 s, with less than 10% rain probability. I assess these conditions meet Small Craft Advisory criteria for the eastern Mediterranean near Mykonos, while Lisbon remains light with winds near 10 kt; I recommend small-boat operators exercise caution offshore and secure loose gear in port.
